cover.title: 5 niche signs you're becoming a terrifyingly good founder

inner.title: they know churn reasons
inner.body: they can name the top reason customers cancel, from exit calls, not guesses. bain tied 5% more retention to over 25% more profit.

inner.title: they watch load time
inner.body: they check how fast their site loads on a phone, weekly. google found 53% of mobile visits get abandoned past 3 seconds, silently.

inner.title: they charge earlier
inner.body: they put a price on it before the product feels ready. a16z's martin casado says no single decision moves your valuation more than pricing.

inner.title: they kill features
inner.body: they delete features nobody touches instead of polishing them for a launch tweet. pendo found 80% of features are rarely or never used.

inner.title: they talk to users
inner.body: they book user calls every week, even when the roadmap feels obvious. yc says early founders should spend almost all their time coding and talking to users.

closer.HEADLINE:
the edge isn't genius.
it's looking first.
